<?php
// E2E probe (test only) for recurring carts on the block checkout.
// - emulates the payment requirements ('subscriptions' / 'pre-orders') that WooCommerce Subscriptions / Pre-Orders add to carts;
// - stands in for the few functions the gateway calls from those plugins (only when switched on through ?cardz3n_e2e=cfg);
// - short-circuits the gateway HTTP and records every request WITHOUT any secret.
// Nothing leaves the machine.
function cz_e2e_has_item( $order, $needle ) {
	foreach ( $order->get_items() as $item ) {
		if ( false !== strpos( $item->get_name(), $needle ) ) { return true; }
	}
	return false;
}
if ( 'yes' === get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_subs' ) && ! class_exists( 'WC_Subscriptions' ) ) { class WC_Subscriptions {} }
if ( 'yes' === get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_preorders' ) && ! class_exists( 'WC_Pre_Orders' ) ) {
	class WC_Pre_Orders {}
	class WC_Pre_Orders_Order {
		public static function order_requires_payment_tokenization( $order ) { return cz_e2e_has_item( $order, 'E2E Preorder' ); }
	}
}

add_action( 'woocommerce_blocks_loaded', function () {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'woocommerce_store_api_register_payment_requirements' ) ) { return; }
	woocommerce_store_api_register_payment_requirements( array(
		'data_callback' => function () {
			$req = array();
			if ( function_exists( 'WC' ) && WC()->cart ) {
				foreach ( WC()->cart->get_cart() as $item ) {
					$name = isset( $item['data'] ) ? $item['data']->get_name() : '';
					if ( false !== strpos( $name, 'E2E Subscription' ) ) { $req[] = 'subscriptions'; }
					if ( false !== strpos( $name, 'E2E Preorder' ) ) { $req[] = 'pre-orders'; }
				}
			}
			return array_values( array_unique( $req ) );
		},
	) );
} );

// Stand-in for the subscription objects and functions (only when the stub is switched on).
add_action( 'woocommerce_init', function () {
	if ( 'yes' !== get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_subs' ) ) { return; }
	if ( ! class_exists( 'CZ_E2E_Subscription' ) ) {
		class CZ_E2E_Subscription extends WC_Order {
			public function get_parent() { $pid = (int) $this->get_meta( '_e2e_parent_id' ); return $pid ? wc_get_order( $pid ) : false; }
		}
	}
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wcs_order_contains_subscription' ) ) {
		function wcs_order_contains_subscription( $order, $types = null ) { $order = is_object( $order ) ? $order : wc_get_order( $order ); return $order && cz_e2e_has_item( $order, 'E2E Subscription' ); }
		function wcs_get_subscriptions_for_order( $order, $args = array() ) {
			$order = is_object( $order ) ? $order : wc_get_order( $order );
			if ( ! $order || ! cz_e2e_has_item( $order, 'E2E Subscription' ) ) { return array(); }
			$sid = (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_sub_of_' . $order->get_id() );
			if ( ! $sid ) {
				$s = new CZ_E2E_Subscription();
				$s->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
				$s->update_meta_data( '_e2e_parent_id', $order->get_id() );
				$s->save();
				$sid = $s->get_id();
				update_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_sub_of_' . $order->get_id(), $sid );
			}
			return array( $sid => new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $sid ) );
		}
		function wcs_get_subscriptions_for_renewal_order( $order ) { return array(); }
		function wcs_is_subscription( $x ) { return $x instanceof CZ_E2E_Subscription; }
	}
} );

// The gateway's HTTP, recorded (no secrets) and answered.
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
	if ( 'yes' !== get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_http' ) || false === strpos( (string) $url, 'transactiongateway' ) ) { return $pre; }
	$b = is_array( $args['body'] ) ? $args['body'] : array();
	if ( ! $b ) { parse_str( (string) $args['body'], $b ); }
	$keep = array( 'type', 'amount', 'customer_vault', 'customer_vault_id', 'initiated_by', 'stored_credential_indicator', 'initial_transaction_id', 'billing_method', 'orderid', 'transactionid' );
	$rec  = array();
	foreach ( $keep as $k ) { if ( isset( $b[ $k ] ) ) { $rec[ $k ] = $b[ $k ]; } }
	$rec['has_token'] = isset( $b['payment_token'] );
	$reqs   = (array) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_reqs', array() );
	$reqs[] = $rec;
	update_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_reqs', $reqs );
	$n    = count( $reqs );
	$body = 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&authcode=A1&transactionid=TX-' . $n;
	if ( ! empty( $b['payment_token'] ) && ( $b['customer_vault'] ?? '' ) === 'add_customer' ) { $body .= '&customer_vault_id=V-' . $n . '&cc_number=4xxxxxxxxxxx1111&cc_exp=1230&cc_type=visa'; }
	return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => $body, 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
}, 10, 3 );

add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) ) { return; }
	$mode = sanitize_key( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] );
	$out  = function ( $d ) { header( 'Content-Type: application/json' ); echo wp_json_encode( $d ); exit; };
	$opt  = 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings';
	$gwid = 'cardz3n_gateway';

	// cfg: stub_subs, stub_pre, http, sw_subs, sw_pre (yes/no); takes effect from the next request.
	if ( 'cfg' === $mode ) {
		$map = array( 'stub_subs' => 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_subs', 'stub_pre' => 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_preorders', 'http' => 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_http' );
		foreach ( $map as $k => $o ) { if ( isset( $_GET[ $k ] ) ) { update_option( $o, 'yes' === $_GET[ $k ] ? 'yes' : 'no' ); } }
		$s = (array) get_option( $opt, array() );
		if ( isset( $_GET['sw_subs'] ) ) { $s['enable_subscriptions'] = 'yes' === $_GET['sw_subs'] ? 'yes' : 'no'; }
		if ( isset( $_GET['sw_pre'] ) ) { $s['enable_preorders'] = 'yes' === $_GET['sw_pre'] ? 'yes' : 'no'; }
		update_option( $opt, $s );
		if ( isset( $_GET['reset_reqs'] ) ) { update_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_reqs', array() ); }
		if ( isset( $_GET['clear_tokens'] ) ) { foreach ( WC_Payment_Tokens::get_tokens( array( 'gateway_id' => $gwid ) ) as $t ) { $t->delete(); } }
		$out( array( 'ok' => true ) );
	}

	// features: what the native block payment method advertises right now.
	if ( 'features' === $mode ) {
		if ( ! class_exists( '\Cardz3n_Gateway\Blocks_Support' ) ) { require_once CARDZ3N_GW_PATH . 'includes/class-cardz3n-blocks-support.php'; }
		$b = new \Cardz3n_Gateway\Blocks_Support();
		$b->initialize();
		$data = $b->get_payment_method_data();
		$gw   = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()[ $gwid ];
		$out( array( 'features' => $b->get_supported_features(), 'data_supports' => $data['supports'], 'active' => $b->is_active(), 'classic_supports' => array_values( $gw->supports ), 'card_saved_text' => $data['i18n']['cardSaved'] ?? '' ) );
	}

	// posts: a block-checkout style post (wc_payment_source=blocks) straight into process_payment(), for each cart type.
	if ( 'posts' === $mode ) {
		if ( function_exists( 'wc_load_cart' ) && null === WC()->session ) { wc_load_cart(); }
		$gw   = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()[ $gwid ];
		$post = function ( $kind = 'card' ) { $_POST = array( 'wc_payment_source' => 'blocks', 'cardz3n_payment_kind' => $kind, 'cardz3n_token_type' => $kind, 'cardz3n_payment_token' => 'tok-e2e', 'cardz3n_card_brand' => 'visa', 'cardz3n_saved_token_id' => '' ); };
		$mk   = function ( $pid, $total ) { $o = wc_create_order(); $o->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' ); $o->add_product( wc_get_product( $pid ), 1 ); $o->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' ); $o->set_total( $total ); $o->save(); return $o; };
		$info = function ( $o ) {
			$o = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() ); $sid = (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_sub_of_' . $o->get_id() ); $sub = $sid ? wc_get_order( $sid ) : false;
			return array( 'status' => $o->get_status(), 'order_vault' => (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id' ), 'order_initial' => (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id' ), 'sub_vault' => $sub ? (string) $sub->get_meta( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id' ) : null );
		};
		$res = array();
		foreach ( array( 'subscription' => 'cardz3n_e2e_pid_sub', 'preorder' => 'cardz3n_e2e_pid_pre', 'normal' => 'cardz3n_e2e_product_id' ) as $label => $pid_opt ) {
			update_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_reqs', array() );
			$o = $mk( (int) get_option( $pid_opt ), '1.00' ); $post();
			$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
			$res[ $label ] = array_merge( array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'requests' => get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_reqs' ) ), $info( $o ) );
		}
		update_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_reqs', array() );
		$o = $mk( (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_pid_sub' ), '1.00' ); $post( 'ach' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$res['subscription_ach'] = array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'requests' => get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_reqs' ) );
		$out( $res );
	}

	// order: read back one order after a real block checkout, plus the recorded gateway requests.
	if ( 'order' === $mode ) {
		$o   = wc_get_order( (int) ( $_GET['id'] ?? 0 ) );
		$sid = $o ? (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_sub_of_' . $o->get_id() ) : 0;
		$sub = $sid ? wc_get_order( $sid ) : false;
		$out( array( 'found' => (bool) $o, 'status' => $o ? $o->get_status() : '', 'order_vault' => $o ? (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id' ) : '', 'order_initial' => $o ? (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id' ) : '', 'sub_vault' => $sub ? (string) $sub->get_meta( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id' ) : null, 'requests' => get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_reqs' ) ) );
	}
}, 20 );
